Gardner CNRA:
The Gardner area is bordered on the south by Willow Street, a major east-west collector street; on the west by Bird Avenue, another collector; on the north by Route 280; and on the east by the proposed alignment of the future Route 87 freeway. The interior neighborhood streets are basically in a grid pattern with some curved streets in the southwest quadrant. Bird Avenue has recently undergone major improvements, including widening and signalization from Coe Avenue north to Route 280, to which it provides access. Previous plans to further widen Bird south from Coe to Willow Street were eliminated in the newly-adopted General Plan of the city. The Bird-Willow intersection was improved in anticipation of the future widening of Bird, both north and south of Willow Street.

Route 25 uses Willow Street to connect the East Valley with the West Valley. Busses 64 and 83 pass north and south through Gardner on Bird and Delmas Streets, respectively, linking north and south San Jose.
